Thursday Community Road Ride (East Coast Bicycles)

Norfolk, VA · Ghent · Road

Thursday Community Road Ride (East Coast Bicycles) is a road group ride in Norfolk, VA. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 pm from East Coast Bicycles. About 20 miles, 15–17 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15–17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Thursday Community Road Ride (East Coast Bicycles) group ride

The shop's mid-pace road ride, 20 miles at 15 to 17 mph. Faster A and B groups go out Tuesdays at 6 and Saturdays at 7 am; Monday nights are a mixed-bag ride with changing themes. ID, helmet and lights required; no headphones.
